args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money quantizes cents with ROUND_HALF_UP while its docstring
and FIN-212 require banker's rounding. This made the nightly build
fail tests/test_money.py (e.g. 2.665 should round to 2.66, not 2.67).

Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to the nearest
even cent.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails in `tests/test_money.py` because it expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented the quantization with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring already claimed banker's rounding.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: `round_money()` now uses `rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. No other changes; signature and behavior for non-half values are unchanged.

## Example

- `2.675` → `2.68` (as before)
- `2.665` → `2.66` (previously `2.67` with HALF_UP)

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed** (includes `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).

Approver: this needs to ship in today's release. COD-792 reference: requires code owner approval for merge into main.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner
